dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 23, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Cardinals Sweep Reds Behind Strong Staff Effort**

In a doubleheader sweep, the St. Louis Cardinals took down the Cincinnati Reds 8-1 and 6-7. Jordan Walker was the star of the show, going 4-for-8 with two home runs, four RBIs, and six total bases. Alec Burleson and Bryan Torres also contributed with strong performances, with Torres hitting his first home run of the season. On the mound, Andre Pallante and Matt Svanson shone, combining for five scoreless innings. 

**Astros Shut Down Cubs 3-0**

The Houston Astros blanked the Chicago Cubs 3-0 behind Kai-Wei Teng's strong outing. Teng tossed six scoreless innings, striking out six and allowing just two hits. Christian Walker led the Astros' offense with two home runs and three RBIs. Walker's 13th home run of the season was a line drive to left center.

**Giants Crush White Sox 10-3**

The San Francisco Giants exploded for 10 runs in a 10-3 win over the Chicago White Sox. Harrison Bader led the charge with two home runs and four RBIs. Willy Adames also homered, his sixth of the season. Matt Gage earned the win with 1.1 scoreless innings of relief.

**Royals Blank Mariners 5-0**

The Kansas City Royals shut down the Seattle Mariners 5-0 behind Stephen Kolek's nine innings of one-hit ball. Carter Jensen drove in two runs for the Royals.
